snippet.title: Meet Grammarly’s Tone Detector
snippet.description:
It’s not just what you say — it’s how you say it. Deliver your message the way you intend to.

Curious to see Grammarly’s tone detector in action? Learn more at grammarly.com/tone.

The beta version of Grammarly’s tone detector is currently available as part of Grammarly’s browser extension for Chrome on email sites such as Gmail and Yahoo. It will be rolled out on Safari and Firefox over the coming weeks and will be available in all text fields soon. 

To give it a try, be sure you have Grammarly for Chrome installed, open up your email, and then start composing. Make sure to write a few sentences—the tone detector needs at least 120 characters to activate.
